title: Ace of Spades
lyrics:
[00:14.14]If you like to gamble
[00:15.80]I tell you, I'm your man
[00:17.27]You win some, lose some
[00:19.46]It's all the same to me
[00:27.67]The pleasure is to play
[00:29.27]Makes no difference what you say
[00:34.64]I don't share your greed
[00:36.30]The only card I need is the ace of spades
[00:39.94]The ace of spades
[00:44.90]Playing for the high one
[00:46.62]Dancing with the devil
[00:48.53]Going with the flow
[00:50.04]It's all a game to me
[00:58.74]Seven or eleven
[01:00.51]Snake eyes watching you
[01:05.66]Double up or quit
[01:07.38]Double stake or split
[01:08.96]The ace of spades
[01:10.59]The ace of spades
[01:19.27]You know I'm born to lose
[01:20.65]And gambling's for fools
[01:22.58]But that's the way I like it, baby
[01:24.64]I don't want to live forever
[01:30.82]And don't forget the joker
[01:59.82]Pushing up the ante
[02:01.68]I know you got to see me
[02:03.27]Read 'em and weep
[02:05.14]The dead man's hand again
[02:13.76]I see it in your eyes
[02:15.55]Take one look and die
[02:20.64]The only thing you see
[02:22.41]You know it's gonna be the ace of spades
[02:25.77]The ace of spades, uh
